test_groupby_categorical_observed_false: test groupby with categorical grouper and observed=False to include unobserved categories in result
test_groupby_categorical_observed_true: test groupby with categorical grouper and observed=True to exclude unobserved categories from result
test_groupby_categorical_sort_order: test groupby with categorical grouper preserves category sort order when sort=True and sort=False
test_groupby_categorical_preserve_dtype: test groupby aggregation preserves categorical dtype on result columns and index
test_groupby_multiindex_categorical: test groupby with multiple categorical columns and MultiIndex result including unobserved category combinations
